_doc: Inputs to parse-script.mjs that the research docs do not provide. (1) uxMeta: priority + delivery for the ux-playability §9 lines (that table has only id/trigger/line); priorities follow audio-plan §4.11 classes. (2) templated: text for the §5.3 templated ids, which the docs name but never script; written by a2-voice in the §5.1 persona and flagged needsReview. (3) legacy: the five legacy GuidedTutorial step lines that have no §5.2 replacement, re-recorded verbatim (text recovered with local Whisper from client/assets/audio/vo, STT slips corrected) so every legacy vo_* name maps to a new file. (4) ttsOverrides: per-line spoken text for any id (a respelling or a comma for one line), applied before the pronunciation.json aliases; the subtitle stays the doc text. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Edit this file, then run `node parse-script.mjs`.

vo_goal_generic.limit: per goal without a specific line (UX §8 #34)

vo_building_first_retail.text: Our first store. Price it smartly and keep those shelves stocked.

vo_building_first_farm.text: Our first farm. Growing our own inputs protects our margins.

vo_building_first_mine_well.text: We're producing our own raw materials now. Price shocks will hurt us less.

vo_building_first_warehouse.text: Our first warehouse. Buffer stock keeps our stores supplied when demand jumps.

vo_building_first_rd.text: Our first R&D center. Better technology means better products and margins.

vo_building_first_media.text: Our first media outlet. Let's put it to work building our brand.

vo_building_first_seaport.text: Our own seaport. Imported goods now come straight to our door.

vo_milestone_1m.text: Our first million in revenue. Now let's make the next one faster.

vo_milestone_10m.text: Ten million in revenue. The business has real momentum now.

vo_milestone_100m.text: A hundred million in revenue. We're a serious player now.

vo_milestone_1b.text: A billion in revenue. That's the mark of a true magnate.

vo_upgrade_first.text: Our first upgrade is complete. More capacity, same address.

vo_tech_max.text: Our technology is the best on the market. Now let's protect that lead.

vo_building_first_.trigger: first construction of this building category (UX §8 #1: construction started; phrased to also fit completion)

vo_tech_max.trigger: player product reaches max tech (UX §8 #22; techMax*)

legacy.text: Every empire starts with a single store. Open Manage, pick a city, and construct your first supermarket.
Shelves do not fill themselves. Assign soft drinks to your store, set your price, and set a restock target.
Time is your engine. Press play and let three months run. Watch the cash begin to flow.
Nobody buys what they have never heard of. Launch a TV campaign and build your brand.
Now scale. Grow your corporate value to $20 million. Your rivals are already moving.
legacy.tts: Now scale. Grow your corporate value to twenty million dollars. Your rivals are already moving.

ttsOverrides._example: "news.market_crash": "Stocks plunge in heavy trading, as panic sweeps the exchange."
ttsOverrides._adv.cash.negative: QA-final: Kokoro phrased the doc text as '...in the red costs, | interest and credibility' (a ~0.35 s break after 'costs' turns the verb into a list item). The comma after 'interest' binds 'costs interest' and moves the break to the list.
ttsOverrides.adv.cash.negative: We're overdrawn. Every month in the red costs interest, and credibility.
